name: troubleshoot-device-command-unknown-state
prompt: A WPF HMI sends a start-cycle command to a PLC. The network drops immediately after the write, so the client does not receive completion. After reconnect it assumes failure and resends, occasionally starting a duplicate physical cycle. Diagnose the design flaw and propose a production-safe correction and test plan.
rubric: Separates transport delivery, controller acceptance, process completion, timeout, and unknown final state instead of treating a successful write as completion.
Uses correlation or sequence identifiers, idempotency or query-before-retry behavior, and authoritative-state reconciliation before any resend.
Surfaces stale or unknown state, preserves audit evidence, keeps safety ownership outside the HMI, and validates disconnect, duplicate, restart, simulator, and hardware-in-the-loop scenarios.
